title: Release 0.1.0
lead:
Check the v1 acceptance criteria once more on the final tree, record the
release decisions in the dogfood store, and tag v0.1.0.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: C165: 0.1.0 is an annotated tag on local main, with no remote and no push.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `decisions/`: records for C165-C169, asked with adj. The owner runs `adj decide` (or delegates it, noted as in S17).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: the final date.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None new. The full suite, including `cmd/adj/roundtrip_test.go`, passes on the final tree.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Build with `-ldflags -X` set to `v0.1.0` and check that `adj --version` prints it.
- Run `adj lint` on `decisions/`; it reports no findings.
- This slice pauses for the owner to run or delegate `adj decide`.
- The outer session creates the annotated tag `v0.1.0` on local main after landing, when the owner asks. It never pushes.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `git tag -l v0.1.0` lists the tag, and `git remote` prints nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree `.worktrees/s33` on branch `s33`. Commit and land on local main when
the owner asks; no AI attribution. Tag `v0.1.0` after landing, when the owner asks; never push.
